prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The new software increases the productivity of our workers significantly.
The new software increase the productivity of our workers significantly.
The new software increasing the productivity of our workers significantly.
answer: The new software increases the productivity of our workers significantly.

wrong.The new software increase the productivi: 主詞 software 是不可數名詞，視為單數，現在簡單式動詞要加 -s，寫成 increases。
wrong.The new software increasing the producti: increasing 只是分詞，不能單獨當句子的主要動詞，這樣整句沒有完整動詞。

why: software 是單數主詞，描述一般事實用現在簡單式，所以動詞是 increases。
tip: software 不可數、視為單數，動詞要加 s。
say: The new software increases the productivity of our workers significantly.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Installing solar panels on the factory roof is a _____ way to cut energy costs over the long term.
options: sustainable
sensitive
seasonal
superficial

wrong.sensitive: sensitive 是「敏感的」，用來形容人或儀器，不能形容降低長期能源成本的做法。
wrong.seasonal: seasonal 是「季節性的」，句子強調長期可持續，與季節無關。
wrong.superficial: superficial 是「表面的、膚淺的」，帶負面意思，不符合句子稱讚太陽能板的語氣。

why: long term 提示要找「可持續的」，sustainable 最能搭配降低能源成本的長期做法。
say: Installing solar panels on the factory roof is a sustainable way to cut energy costs over the long term.

text: Automation has not replaced the workforce; it has changed the skills the workforce needs.
options: 自動化沒有取代員工，而是改變了員工所需的技能。
自動化取代了所有員工，所以不再需要任何技能。
自動化讓員工的技能變得完全不重要。
自動化只改變了工廠的位置，員工技能不變。
answer: 自動化沒有取代員工，而是改變了員工所需的技能。

wrong.自動化取代了所有員工，所以不再需要任何技能。: 原句 has not replaced 是否定，說自動化並沒有取代員工，這個選項把意思完全弄反。
wrong.自動化讓員工的技能變得完全不重要。: 原句說技能「改變」，不是「不重要」；後半句的 the skills ... needs 表示仍然需要技能。
wrong.自動化只改變了工廠的位置，員工技能不變。: 原句沒有提到工廠位置，而且明確說 changed the skills，技能是會變的。

why: not A; it has B 的結構是「不是 A，而是 B」，A 是取代員工，B 是改變所需技能。
tip: not A; B 要讀成「不是 A，而是 B」。
say: Automation has not replaced the workforce; it has changed the skills the workforce needs.

prompt: 你在寫報告摘要，想表示「除了成本下降，這個計畫還提升了安全」。哪一句最適合？
options: In addition to lowering costs, the project improved safety.
In addition lowering costs, the project improved safety.
In addition to lower costs, the project is improve safety.
Besides of lowering costs, the project improved safety.
answer: In addition to lowering costs, the project improved safety.

wrong.In addition lowering costs, the project: in addition 後面要接 to 才能帶出名詞或動名詞，少了 to 文法不完整。
wrong.In addition to lower costs, the project: 後半句 is improve 把 be 動詞和原形動詞混用，應該用 improved。
wrong.Besides of lowering costs, the project i: besides 本身就是介系詞，不能再加 of；台灣學習者常把 besides of 當成一組。

why: in addition to 後接名詞或動名詞，正好表達「除了……之外還」，後半句動詞時態也正確。
tip: in addition to 後面接 V-ing，to 是介系詞。
say: In addition to lowering costs, the project improved safety.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The efficiency of the plant depends on regular maintenance.
The efficiency of the plant depends of regular maintenance.
The efficiency of the plant depend on regular maintenance.
The efficiency of the plant is depends on regular maintenance.
answer: The efficiency of the plant depends on regular maintenance.

wrong.The efficiency of the plant depends of r: depend 固定搭配 on，不是 of；中文「取決於」容易讓人誤用 of。
wrong.The efficiency of the plant depend on re: 真正的主詞是 efficiency（單數），不是 plant，所以動詞要用 depends。
wrong.The efficiency of the plant is depends o: is 與 depends 同時出現，一個句子不能有兩個主要動詞，只留 depends 即可。

why: depend on 是固定片語，主詞 efficiency 是單數，現在式要加 s。
tip: depend on；主詞看 of 前面的名詞。
say: The efficiency of the plant depends on regular maintenance.

prompt: 你要用英文寫摘要，把一段長文章的重點濃縮成一句話。下列哪一句最像好的摘要句？
options: The article argues that remote monitoring lowers repair costs and reduces unplanned downtime.
The article is about many things, such as machines, people, and also some other things.
The article says that on Monday, a manager named Tom walked into the third meeting room.
The article is long and has seven paragraphs with a lot of examples.
answer: The article argues that remote monitoring lowers repair costs and reduces unplanned downtime.

wrong.The article is about many things, such a: 這句太籠統，沒有指出文章的主要論點，讀者看完仍然不知道文章在說什麼。
wrong.The article says that on Monday, a manag: 這是細節而不是重點，摘要應該刪掉非必要的例子與人名。
wrong.The article is long and has seven paragr: 這只描述文章的長度和結構，沒有說出文章的內容或主張。

why: 好的摘要句要用 argues 這類動詞點出核心主張，並包含最重要的成果，不寫次要細節。
tip: 摘要先寫主張與結果，刪掉人名與細節。
say: The article argues that remote monitoring lowers repair costs and reduces unplanned downtime.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Our company wants to _____ its dependence on a single supplier by finding two more partners.
options: reduce
reserve
receive
reflect

wrong.reserve: reserve 是「預訂、保留」，不能搭配 dependence 表示降低依賴。
wrong.receive: receive 是「收到」，意思無法連到「找兩個新夥伴」這個目的。
wrong.reflect: reflect 是「反映、反思」，放在這裡語意不通。

why: 找更多夥伴的目的是減少對單一供應商的依賴，所以要用 reduce。
tip: reduce dependence on 是常見搭配。
say: Our company wants to reduce its dependence on a single supplier by finding two more partners.

prompt: 這段話中的 expenses 最可能是什麼意思？
text: Please keep every receipt. Travel expenses will be reimbursed only if the original receipt is attached.
options: 費用，開銷
收入，營收
利潤，獲利
薪水，工資

wrong.收入，營收: 收入是 income 或 revenue；這裡是拿收據去報銷，是花出去的錢。
wrong.利潤，獲利: 利潤是 profit，指賺到的錢；報銷的是出差花費，不是利潤。
wrong.薪水，工資: 薪水是 salary 或 wages，不需要附收據報銷。

why: receipt 和 reimbursed（報銷）都表示先花錢再拿回，所以 expenses 是費用開銷。
say: Travel expenses will be reimbursed only if the original receipt is attached.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Sensors help teams find problems before the equipment breaks down.
Sensors help teams to finding problems before the equipment breaks down.
Sensors help teams find problems before the equipment will break down.
Sensors helps teams find problems before the equipment breaks down.
answer: Sensors help teams find problems before the equipment breaks down.

wrong.Sensors help teams to finding problems b: help 後面接原形動詞或 to + 原形，不能接 to + V-ing。
wrong.Sensors help teams find problems before: before 引導的時間副詞子句，用現在式代替未來式，不能加 will。
wrong.Sensors helps teams find problems before: Sensors 是複數，動詞要用 help，不是 helps。

why: help 可接原形動詞；before 子句用現在簡單式；複數主詞搭配 help。
tip: 時間子句不用 will；help 後接原形。
say: Sensors help teams find problems before the equipment breaks down.

prompt: 主管問你：「你的摘要為什麼刪掉這個例子？」你想回答：因為它不是必要的。哪一句最自然？
options: I left it out because it isn't essential to the main point.
I left out it because it not essential to the main point.
I leave it out because it wasn't essentials to the main point.
I left it out because it isn't essential for the main point is.
answer: I left it out because it isn't essential to the main point.

wrong.I left out it because it not essential t: 代名詞 it 要放在 left 和 out 中間；而且 not essential 前面缺少 be 動詞 isn't。
wrong.I leave it out because it wasn't essenti: 時態不一致，而且 essential 是形容詞，不能加 s 變成 essentials。
wrong.I left it out because it isn't essential: 句尾多了 is，整句出現兩個動詞而不成立；essential 後面接 to the main point 就完整。

why: leave out 搭配代名詞時要拆開成 leave it out；essential to 表示對……是必要的。
tip: 代名詞夾在片語動詞中間：left it out。
say: I left it out because it isn't essential to the main point.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The factory needs an extra _____ of ten workers during the busy holiday season.
options: workforce
workshop
worksheet
workout

wrong.workshop: workshop 是「工作坊、研習」或小型作業場，不是人力。
wrong.worksheet: worksheet 是「作業單、工作表」，無法拿來形容十位工人。
wrong.workout: workout 是「運動訓練」，與工廠的人力需求無關。

why: 句意是旺季需要增加人力，workforce 指全體從業人員或勞動力。
tip: workforce 指一個單位的全部勞動人力。
say: The factory needs an extra workforce of ten workers during the busy holiday season.
